Folks — looked through the numbers and ran a quick back-of-envelope on unit economics for this ask. If we grant 200k tokens (mixed gen + embeddings) the estimated marginal cost to Redwood is ~ $420 (with current batching/quantization settings).

Recommendation: grant the credits under the following conditions:
1) Limited one-time credit of 200k tokens, revoked if usage looks anomalous (spike beyond 2x forecast).
2) 30-day extension tied to a short success checklist (demo recording + one integration validation run).
3) A written one-paragraph customer quote + approved marketing permission (for a case study).
4) Legal to prepare a short amendment (no commercial changes, only sandbox/credit extension).

If Legal flags anything, copy Laura_Bennett and Ill pause. Otherwise I think this is a low-cost, high-signal move.

— Monica
